scope: Three alternating pairs on a shared host, fresh copied SQLite database and mount for each variant. Warm metadata and OS caches, direct I/O, FULL commits, no FUSE debug. Owned builds/tests finished before measurement. Native SQL instrumentation runs separately after each unmount. Preparation and validation are untimed. Other host jobs remain active.

validation.test_scope: Related component tests only; no base/full Vane suite.

write_through_prototype.scope: Diagnostic only, FUSE debug enabled. Cached write-through prototype uses the unchanged FULL SQLite core.
write_through_prototype.decision: Keep production direct I/O. Cached write-through halves unaligned WRITE requests but also enables shared writable mmap; its dirty pages follow separate fsync/msync semantics. The existing API excludes this feature.
